description: UCL Student Union Ticket Request Form (TRF): asks the Union to put paid tickets (or a product such as kit) on sale on the SU website. SCAFFOLD: every field below is drafted from the SU's public guidance and has an unconfirmed selector (confirmed: false). The president or treasurer submits it at least 10 working days before the event (or the products' on-sale date), and only after the event has a What's On listing, because the form asks for that page's URL. Prerequisites the Union checks: an approved Activity Registration Form if the event spends £350 or more (the TRF's breakdown must match the ARF's); an approved Additional Risk Assessment for one-off or high-risk events; an approved External Speaker Request Form for an external speaker; an approved Charity Permission Letter for charity fundraising; an approved design for kit or merchandise; an approved Coach/Instructor Registration and Contract for coached sessions. Prices can differ for UCL students, concessions, members and external attendees, with optional early-bird tiers. Free tickets don't need this form: the society creates them itself on the SU website. Cash door sales are only allowed when a ticket costs £10 or less. Tickets must never be sold through third-party sites such as Eventbrite.

verified: url: linked as the Ticket Request Form from studentsunionucl.org/committee-hub; the guide's /forms/ticket-request-form-0 redirects here (checked 2026-10-23)
login_required: anonymous visitors get the page title and 'You need to log in in to complete this form.', not the form (checked 2026-10-23)

the form asks for the What's On event page URL, and the prerequisites, prices, cash-sales and deadline rules: /how-to/clubs-and-societies/sell-event-tickets-or-products and /how-to/clubs-and-societies/organising-activities-events (checked 2026-10-23)

fields.name: club_society
fields.description: Club or Society Name (type to search, Enter to select). The payment and purchase forms share this element; assumed here too.

fields.name: request_type
fields.description: Event tickets, or a product such as kit or merchandise (Default: Event tickets)

fields.name: whats_on_url
fields.description: URL of the event's What's On page (studentsunionucl.org/whats-on/...). Create the listing first.

fields.name: event_name
fields.description: Event (or product) name, as it should appear on the ticket

fields.name: venue
fields.description: Venue; any college or Union room or bar must already be booked

fields.name: activity_registration_form
fields.description: The approved Activity Registration Form submission. Needed when the event spends £350 or more; its budget must match this form's ticket breakdown.

fields.name: who_can_attend
fields.description: Who may come: members only, UCL students, alumni, members of the public

fields.name: cash_door_sales
fields.description: Will tickets also be sold for cash on the door? Only allowed at £10 or less; keep a record of each buyer and deposit the cash at Activities Reception. (Default: No)

fields.name: ticket_tiers
fields.description: One line per ticket type: name, price and how many. Different prices for UCL students, concessions, members and externals are allowed, and early-bird tiers.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: How many of this ticket to sell

fields.name: audience
fields.description: Who can buy this ticket (members, UCL students, concessions, anyone)

fields.name: additional_information
fields.description: Anything else the Union needs (on-sale and off-sale dates, restrictions)
